judgments.reasoning_cat1: A very long provision mixing an absolute duty ('shall cause the Servicers to perform and observe the covenants') with broad discretion ('full power and authority to do any and all things which it may deem necessary or desirable'), and the reconciliation sentence refers back to 'the previous sentence' loosely.
judgments.reasoning_cat2: The absolute 'shall cause the Servicers to perform' duty here is measured in Section 4.03(b) by a much softer standard ('as the Master Servicer in its good faith business judgment would require were it the owner'), so the two sections state the same duty differently.

judgments.reasoning_cat2: The enforcement standard here ('as it would were it the owner of the related Mortgage Loans') is softer than the absolute duty to 'cause the Servicers to perform' in Section 4.01, and the last sentence potentially obliges the Trustee to assume master servicing, which Section 8.06 governs.
